description: Create docker-compose-pd-v4flash-b300.yaml for 3P1D PD disaggregation on B300 (3 prefill engines tp=2 + 1 decode engine tp=2 + sglang-router)
steps: Create scripts/docker-compose-pd-v4flash-b300.yaml with 5 services: prefill-0 (GPU 0,1, port 30000, bootstrap 9000), prefill-1 (GPU 2,3, port 30100, bootstrap 9100), prefill-2 (GPU 4,5, port 30200, bootstrap 9200), decode-0 (GPU 6,7, port 30300, bootstrap 9300), router (port 30080)
All engine services use image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130 (NOT v0.5.12.post1)
Set SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=16384 (NOT 8320, proven by c1n server.log ValueError)
Do NOT include --enable-dp-attention (proven to cause AssertionError on this model/hardware)

Router service uses lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130 (same pinned version, not latest), runs: python3 -m sglang_router.launch_router --pd-disaggregation --prefill http://127.0.0.1:30000 9000 --prefill http://127.0.0.1:30100 9100 --prefill http://127.0.0.1:30200 9200 --decode http://127.0.0.1:30300 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30080 --worker-startup-timeout-secs 2400 --request-timeout-secs 3600
All services use network_mode: host, ipc: host, shm_size: 16g, volumes mount /opt/dlami/nvme:/opt/dlami/nvme and a jitcache volume to /root/.cache
Use NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES env var (not deploy.resources.reservations) for GPU assignment: 0,1 / 2,3 / 4,5 / 6,7
Add depends_on with service_healthy condition so router starts after all engines
Add healthcheck to each engine service: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:<port>/health with appropriate interval/timeout/retries for 30-min cold start
Add comments at top explaining: this is for on-machine verification, nixl backend must be confirmed working in Phase 2 gate before using this in production
acceptance_criteria: File docker-compose-pd-v4flash-b300.yaml exists in scripts/ directory
YAML is syntactically valid (python3 -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open(...))')
Contains exactly 5 services: prefill-0, prefill-1, prefill-2, decode-0, router
Image is v0.5.17-cu130 for all services (not v0.5.12.post1)
--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl is present on all engines
Timeout env vars (WAITING_TIMEOUT=1800, BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=1800) are set
verification: python3 -c "import yaml; y=yaml.safe_load(open('scripts/docker-compose-pd-v4flash-b300.yaml')); assert len(y['services'])==5; print('YAML valid, 5 services')"
